label: D2 state-reached signal: rare a1->S2 strongly lowers, rare a2->S1 raises (grows late)
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * (action == 1) ;; (phase == D2) * (state==S1)*(action==2) * ep_trial ;; (phase == D2) * (state == S2) * ep_trial ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 0) * ep_trial ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_state == S1) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward==1) * (prev_state==S2) ;; (phase == D2) * (prev_reward==0) * (prev_state==S1)
explanation: Raw GRU candidate n of unit 27. Near +1 at D1/GO and declining through the episode (timing R^2 0.58). Beyond timing, the main driver is the D2 choice x reached-state code. A rare a1->S2 transition drops it by about 0.75. A rare a2->S1 transition raises it, and that rise grows with episode trial (about +0.007 per trial). Reaching S2 drives it lower as the episode goes on (about -0.0036 per trial). Common a1->S1 sits mildly above the baseline. At D1/GO it is lower after an unrewarded previous trial (scaled by episode trial) and after a previous S1 state. At D2 it is higher after a rewarded S2 trial and lower after an unrewarded S1 trial. Every term is observed when it applies: action and state are known at D2. Hidden good state, value and future reward add little (reference scores 0.02-0.04). Three D2 choice x state terms alone reach dev 0.72. The 7-term model reaches test R^2 beyond timing 0.86, against an all ceiling of 0.87 and an all-observed ceiling of 0.84.

issues: Minor: the rise after a rare a2->S1 transition grows with episode trial and is about zero early on. Adding a constant (phase==D2)*(state==S1)*(action==2) term gets weight -0.02 and leaves test R^2 at 0.8597, so 'raises' only holds from mid-episode onward. The explanation states the ep_trial scaling, so this is not a contradiction.

Minor leftover error: the misses output under-predicts D2 after a previous a1 S2 u trial by +0.149. Adding (phase==D2)*last_is('a1 S2 u') lifts test R^2 beyond timing from 0.860 to 0.869, about the 'all' ceiling of 0.87. Other phase-level errors are small (D1/GO -0.017, D2 +0.034).

The D1/GO previous-trial terms add about 0.07 (D2 choice x state plus D1/GO terms only: test 0.843). The D2 previous-trial terms add about 0.02 (D2 choice x state plus D2 previous-trial terms only: test 0.793). Both match the stated directions.

The claim that three D2 choice x state terms reach 0.72 is right only for the constant versions (test 0.720). The ep_trial-scaled versions as written in the model reach 0.771. Both are consistent with the explanation.
Checked: the reported 7-term score reproduces exactly (test 0.8596). No future, hidden or model-output variables are used. Adding a GO choice x ep_trial term adds nothing (0.8598).
